help: duration waits the same number of seconds for every message. until releases at an ISO 8601 instant.
Delay from the arrival of each message, from 0.1 to 86400 seconds (24 hours).
ISO 8601 instant with an offset or Z, for example 2026-10-10T14:30:00Z. A past instant releases at once.
Optional JSON Pointer read in each JSON message, for example /release_at. When set, it replaces until.
Send messages dropped by cancel, refused at admission or stopped in One Shot to the cancelled output, with the reason.
Maximum number of messages waiting at once. Further messages are refused and reported.
Maximum size of one message in UTF-8 bytes. Larger messages are refused and reported without their content.
Maximum total size of the waiting messages, in bytes. It bounds the memory used by this node.
